Mingming, Xiaohan, and Weiguang are friends, they plan to drive for a trip together. The three of them do not decide where to go, so they are discussing the details of the trip at this moment. Among many tourist attractions, most tourists choose attractions A and B, and fewer people choose attraction C. Xiaohan shows Mingming the screenshot of the netizen's share of attraction C that she saves before, and says to Mingming, "Look at this". Weiguang looks back at Xiaohan and smiles at Mingming. Mingming takes the phone, the corners of his mouth rise.

[Question]
What does Mingming do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Mingming plans a trip with attraction A as the target.
B. Mingming proposes to travel to attraction C.
C. Mingming knows that attractions A and B are too crowded, but still tells Xiaohan that he wants to go to attraction A.
D. Ask Xiaohan about her opinion on attraction C.
